takes.title: Walking with relaxed arms
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-stride and continues alternating walking steps with a small arm swing, ending mid-stride.

takes.title: Forward basketball dribble
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with one hand extended and walks with repeated downward hand movements, then lowers the hand and settles into a bent-knee stance.

takes.title: Forward basketball dribble with short steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with one hand extended, takes short steps while repeatedly lowering and raising the hand, and ends still moving.

takes.title: Walking forward while dribbling
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-step and walks with repeated one-handed motions near the torso and side, ending mid-stride.

takes.title: Forward dribble with hand motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts leaning slightly with a hand extended and steps while repeatedly lowering and raising it, finishing with arms nearer the body.

takes.title: Backward basketball dribble
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts bent forward, takes short steps while repeatedly moving one hand down and up, and finishes in a low stance.

takes.title: Backward dribble and low steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with a hand out, bends forward into short low steps and repeated hand motions, then rises slightly while continuing to step.

takes.title: Sideways basketball dribble
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts leaning with one hand low, takes repeated lateral steps while moving the hand up and down, and ends in a wide stance.

takes.title: Low sideways basketball dribble
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts in a forward lean and repeats lateral steps with a low hand motion, ending in a wide bent-knee stance.

takes.title: Forward dribble with left turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with one hand extended, steps and turns through several orientations while making repeated low hand motions, and finishes walking.

takes.title: Forward dribble with right turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts stepping with a hand extended, turns through several orientations with bent knees and low hand motions, then continues stepping.

takes.sourceDescription: basketball - forward dribble, 90-degree right turns, crossover dribble
takes.title: Dribble with right turns and crossover
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with one hand out, steps and turns through several orientations, brings the hands across the body, and ends in a low stepping stance.

takes.sourceDescription: basketball - low, fast free style dribble, dribble through legs
takes.title: Low freestyle basketball dribbling
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, drops into a low wide stance and moves through repeated quick steps, turns, and alternating low hand reaches, ending while still moving.

takes.title: Crossover dribble and basketball shot
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with one hand out, bends and brings the hands across the body, rises and extends both arms overhead in a shooting motion, then lowers them and steps away.

takes.title: Basketball dribble and shot
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with one hand extended, bends into a low hand motion, brings both hands upward and extends them overhead, then lands and returns to standing.
